name: MKT_CM_SYSTASKS
description: This table stores the Stage execution progress in form of the actual server tasks being executed.

columns.name: SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: Column holds the systask id. This is a primary key as well

columns.name: OBJECT_DETAIL_NAME
columns.description: This Column specifies the language independent code of the object

columns.name: OBJECT_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Column holds the object sequence corrsponding to the systask

columns.name: ENABLE_OBJECT
columns.description: This Column specifies the object selected for import.

columns.name: ROOT_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: Column holds the root systask id for an import job

columns.name: IMPORT_MAP_ID
columns.description: Column holds the import map id corrsponding to the systask

columns.name: FILES_PATH
columns.description: Column holds the path for all the improt files(SQLLDR Cntrl file, Data file, log file, BAD file, zip files and individual csv files) created in the system

columns.name: BATCH_LEVEL
columns.description: Column holds the level of the system task. Parent Level system task will be 1, next child level will be 2 and so on.

columns.name: INTERFACE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Column holds the interface table name

columns.name: PARTITION_NAME
columns.description: Column holds the partition name created for an interface table

columns.name: IMPORT_OBJECT_CD
columns.description: Column holds the import object code (Ex: LEAD,ASSET)

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS16
columns.description: Indicates whether the value was invoked from UI

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS17
columns.description: Contains new  File Import Status values

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS15
columns.description: Holds the number of data elements being processed by an import job, [sum of (row*column product), for all csv files in an import job], used for calculating estimated time to completion for an import job

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS14
columns.description: Used for storing estimated time to completion for an import job

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS13
columns.description: Would hold a flag denoting whether the file import was invoked using UI or a web-service

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS12
columns.description: Number of records with warnings

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS11
columns.description: It will hold import_job_number from mkt_imp_jobs. It will be used primarily by the seeded jobs created by file import.

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS6
columns.description: Column holds the Accept Log file name

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS10
columns.description: Column holds the value MULTI_CSV if import job is ZIP Import

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS7
columns.description: Column holds the Reject Log file name

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS8
columns.description: Column holds the Error Log file name

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS9
columns.description: Column holds the import Job parameters

columns.name: PARENT_TASK_ID
columns.description: Column holds the pareant systask id of the systask

columns.name: TASK_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Column holds the task type code

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Column holds the Schedule Program

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Column holds the Scheduler Program Application

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Column holds the error message for systask

columns.name: STATUS_CD
columns.description: Column holds the System Task Status

columns.name: START_DT
columns.description: Column holds the start date of systask

columns.name: END_DT
columns.description: Column holds the end date of systask

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Column holds the object type code

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Column holds the import job id corrsponds to the systask

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS1
columns.description: Column holds the total no of records in the import Job

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS2
columns.description: Column holds the number of Success records

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS3
columns.description: Column holds the Load Error Row Count

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS4
columns.description: Column holds the Format Error Row Count

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS5
columns.description: Column holds the name of Source CSV in ZIP Import

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: IMPORT_TYPE
columns.description: Import Type Specifies the type of import, whether it is simplified, standard, optimized or classic import

columns.name: PURGE_FLAG
columns.description: This column is to store if the batch is purged or not. Accepted values Y/N.

columns.name: VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: This column is to store the visible flag. This can take value Y or N. If it is N, batch will not be shown on UI

columns.name: UCM_PURGE_FLAG
columns.description: This column is to store the UCM purge flag. If the flag is 'Y' then the files of the corresponding batch is purged.

columns.name: MESSAGE_CODE
columns.description: This column is used to store MessageCode
